banner.title: certificates
banner.tagline: Keeps the wildcard certificate in 1Password, so a rebuilt cluster restores it instead of spending a new issuance.

art.about: how a TLS pair is restored and exported
art.title: Certificate restore and export

explainer.title: A TLS pair that survives a rebuild

steps.title: Restore
steps.text: On create, ExternalSecret sklab-dev-tls pulls item sklab-dev-tls from 1Password into a kubernetes.io/tls Secret of the same name, then leaves it alone.
steps.scene: a sealed envelope opening into a document

steps.title: Issue
steps.text: cert-manager issues Certificate sklab-dev-production from the letsencrypt-production ClusterIssuer and writes Secret sklab-dev-production-tls.
steps.scene: a certificate document receiving a wax seal

steps.title: Export
steps.text: PushSecret sklab-dev-tls copies tls.crt and tls.key from that Secret back into the same 1Password item, base64 encoded.
steps.scene: a document sliding into a vault door
